messages:
sophia: heads-up — seeing a weird accuracy delta in AWQ-INT8 runs for longform generation. short Q/A and snippet tests look fine, but long-form outputs start hallucinating citations and introduce formatting noise after ~600 tokens. anyone else seeing length-dependent regressions?

kevin: :eyes: which model and which quant path (our awq build or third-party)?

sophia: model: redwood/gpt-large-v2 (onnx->awq-int8 path we built in infra). commit: 2a7b5f3. eval harness: `evals/longform_v1` on dev split. quick aggregate: FP16 baseline Rouge-L 42.1, AWQ-INT8 34.7 (drop ~7.4). but EM on short snippets stays ~92%. so problem grows with sequence length.

lia: can you paste the eval command and one failing sample (prompt + model output)? even a short excerpt helps.

sophia: sure — command I ran:```bash
./run_eval --model=redwood/gpt-large-v2:2a7b5f3 --quant=awq-int8 --dataset=longform_v1 --max_new_tokens=1024 --batch_size=8 --seed=42 --out=artifacts/awq-run-1807.json
```results snippet (paired with FP16):```json
{
  "id": "doc_129",
  "prompt_len": 174,
  "fp16_output_excerpt": "...In 2019, the survey by X et al. concluded that... [ref: Smith2019]",
  "awq_int8_output_excerpt": "...In 2019, a study concluded that companies were using best practices. See the report by the policy office.",
  "notes": "hallucinated a generic citation and removed explicit ref tag. longer context shows more drift after token 600"
}
```

eval-bot: run complete — artifacts uploaded to https://internal-artifacts/redwood/awq-run-1807 (size 1.4GB). summary: 1,200 examples, mean rouge-l delta -7.4, std 1.6, length bucketed drop increases monotonically (0-200: -0.3, 200-600: -2.1, 600+: -11.2).

noah: hmm. batch_size=8 — can you repro with batch_size=1 and single-threaded runtime? continuous batching or KV merging might be the culprit.

sophia: queued a run with `--batch_size=1 --workers=1` now, will post link when done.

kevin: also check the AWQ group-size / block-size used by the quantizer. small group sizes can cause scale mismatch across long-range layers. what group-size did you use?

sophia: used default `group_size=128` from our awq pipeline.

lia: two quick triage items: 1) tokenization boundary changes (we recently changed the bpe merges for some punctuation) can cause subtle shifts in long-form alignment; 2) KV cache flushing/overwrite if the runtime uses rolling KV segments with quantized keys. i can audit tokenization diffs for the eval set.

kevin: i'm going to spin up a GPTQ INT8 run for the same commit to compare. if GPTQ doesn't show the same length slope, likely an AWQ-specific quant kernel issue. if both fail, maybe compilation/attention kernel change.

noah: i'll reproduce with `--max_new_tokens=2048 --batch_size=1` and add detailed mem/kvcache logging:```json
{"kvcache_trace": true, "log_level": "debug", "dump_steps": [600,800,1000]}
```should help see if keys degrade or get overwritten.

sophia: thanks — also adding a short eval of structured output (tables) since we noticed formatting errors in outputs as well. linking to a sample failing doc: https://internal-artifacts/redwood/awq-run-1807/doc_129.txt

lia: i'll diff tokenization and run an alignment check between FP16 and AWQ outputs at token level (leverage `scripts/align_tokens.py`). might reveal a systematic offset after some token index.

kevin: if we see KV corruption, fallback policy in runtime should route long requests to FP16/dedicated pool. can we enable a canary that routes >600 tokens to FP16 for a small percentage of traffic? ops can configure.

sophia: ops: can we enable a 5% FP16 fallback for requests with `requested_new_tokens > 600` on the canary tier? this is for risk mitigation while we triage.

noah: I'll run the bisect between awq group_size 64/128/256 and GPTQ-INT8 tomorrow morning; will post diffs. target: identify earliest change that increases length-dependent loss.

lia: tagging datasets/splits as well — please include `longform_v1--noisy-citations` subset, that's where the hallucination spike is concentrated.

kevin: timeline: kevin/gptq run by EOD, noah bisect by tomorrow AM, lia tokenization diff within 3 hours, sophia will enable structured-output eval. we'll meet in #eng-ml in 6h to sync. :calendar:

sophia: appreciated — i'll also add a quick repro notebook in `notebooks/awq-longform-debug.ipynb` with the failing prompt and seeds so others can repro locally.

kevin: if we confirm AWQ-specific, plan is: 1) revert to last-awq-stable quant parameters for production; 2) patch quant kernel and add regression test (longform_v1 length buckets) to CI.

lia: note for CI test: include token-level alignment metric and a hallucination detector score (we have a small classifier for extraneous-citation tokens).

sophia: ok queued tasks. i'll update thread with the single-batch run when it finishes. thanks all. :pray:

kevin: noted.

noah: queued the kvcache-verbose run now (ETA ~40m).

eval-bot: new artifact uploaded: https://internal-artifacts/redwood/awq-run-1807-batch1 (kvcache logs included).
